annotations.title: SEC EDGAR filings + company facts bundle

description: [PAID — 0.03 USDC on Base via x402] edgar_filings + edgar_company_facts for one company in a single paid call — cheaper than buying both separately ($0.04). $0.03 USDC on Base, paid via x402 by the calling agent's own wallet. Call with no payment_header first to receive the payment requirements; your own wallet pays, never this server's.

cik.description: SEC CIK number, if known (overrides ticker lookup).

concepts.description: Specific XBRL concept names to fetch.

form.description: Filter filings to one form type, e.g. 10-K.

payment_header.description: Optional. Omit on your first call to receive the x402 payment challenge for free. After your own wallet/x402 client signs against that challenge, call this same tool again with the SAME business arguments plus this field set to the header your x402 client produced (typically { name: "PAYMENT-SIGNATURE", value: "<base64 payload>" }). This server never holds a wallet and never pays on your behalf.

name.description: HTTP header name to attach, e.g. PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

value.description: HTTP header value (the signed payment payload).

since.description: ISO date; only filings on/after this date.

until.description: ISO date; only filings on/before this date.
